title: Conformance of the data space rulebook to the common interoperability baseline

statement.en: The governance authority shall publish its rulebook in machine-readable form, at the endpoint defined at Level 0 where one is defined, and every rule that implements a Level 0 rule shall declare it as its parent rule and shall include at least the Level 0 minimum fields and values; Level 2 and Level 3 rules shall conform to their parent rule in the same way.

control: At every rulebook release and whenever the Level 0 baseline changes: a validator checks that each rule declaring a Level 0 parent contains its minimum fields and values, then a reviewer checks that local additions do not weaken the parent. A failed check blocks the release from being listed as conformant
trustFramework: Decided rule by rule: the checked rule follows the trust framework of its parent rule

expressions.note: Validator on the machine-readable rulebook: parent rules resolve, Level 0 fields and values present, parameters only made stricter. The validator of this bank does part of it.
Reviewer confirms that local rules only add to their parent rule.

source: DS4Skills rulebook v0.4 GOV-01, POL-04, POL-13
